observations.contract: Hashing concatenated base64 checksum text is wrong: CompleteSnapshot initially returns 202 pending, then EC2 reports error with StateMessage='Checksum mismatch for snapshot'. Use concatenated binary SHA256 digests, as verified by blocks.json.
All three aggregate checksum fields must be present together; incomplete sets return HTTP 400 ValidationException, INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

The service accepts 255-character ClientToken and rejects 256 characters; the API reference matches this, while the user-guide idempotency page's 64-character statement is narrower than observed admission.
